name: Seligenstadt (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Seligenstadt (a black imperial eagle on yellow and a white Mainz wheel on red).
history: The flag was approved by the Hessian Ministry of the Interior on 23 October 1957.

features.role: Seligenstadt arms — eagle and Mainz wheel
